about: Acceptance gates of the head pose against the Windows Stream Engine's (the DLL's), per session: bounds on the metrics of `tobii5-init-replay compare-dll sessionN.bin sessionN.jsonl --head --gates tools/headpose/gates.json`, which replays the session's IR images through the daemon's head pose (HeadStep, HeadParams::FITTED) and pairs each image with the DLL's pose of it. A gate by compare-dll is checked there, and fails the run when it fails. A gate by python bounds the lag or the rest jitter of the filters, which are measured in Python from the run's --csv rows against the head-pose study's stateless reference; compare-dll lists it unchecked. Images: ALL are those on which the DLL's pose and ours are both valid; COMB those of ALL where the DLL's |yaw| is above 15 deg and its |pitch| above 8 deg or its |roll| above 10 deg. Errors: of each yxz angle, |wrap(ours - DLL)|, deg; geodesic, the angle of R_ours^T R_DLL with R = Ry(y) Rx(x) Rz(z), deg; of the position, |ours - DLL| along each axis of the display frame, mm. A median or percentile interpolates linearly between ranks, as NumPy's default does.
status: set on 2026-10-05 from the Rust pipeline, with HeadParams::FITTED fitted on the Rust tracker's fits of s1-s3: each threshold is the metric's leave-one-session-out value plus headroom (see headroom). tools/headpose/gates.py applies that rule: from that refit's fit.json and fits (fixtures/analysis/headpose-2026-09-27/impl/tune-refit/) it writes these thresholds again
headroom: Each threshold is the metric's leave-one-session-out value, that of the Rust pipeline with the constants fitted on the other two sessions, moved by the headroom below, as tools/headpose/gates.py sets it. The value is what `evaluate.py --params fit.json --loso` prints with --reference-fits the study's stateless reference, fixtures/analysis/headpose-2026-09-27/work2/filter-identify/runs/sl_s{1,2,3}.npz: the Python twin of head.rs (which agrees with it to ~1e-12) over the Rust tracker's fits, its lag and rest jitter measured against that reference. The headroom: coverage and agreement 0.5 percentage points (rounded down to 0.1); loss events one fewer than found, but none fewer in s3, whose two long losses must both be found; the rotation medians and the |median signed pitch error| 30 % of the value, at least 0.25 deg (rounded up to 0.1), but G7 in s3 midway between its value (1.85) and that of the pipeline without Q (2.35), which no other gate catches there; the rotation p95s 20 %, at least 1 deg (up to 0.5); the position medians 30 %, at least 0.5 mm (up to 0.1); the position p95 z 20 %, at least 5 mm (up to 1); the lags 5 ms (up to 1); the jitter ranges 0.2 below and 0.3 above (out to 0.1). Checked: the shipped pipeline (compare-dll --head with HeadParams::FITTED, and its CSV through evaluate.py) and the twin with the leave-one-session-out constants pass every gate in every session; each broken pipeline (evaluate.py --broken zyx, q-transposed, no-q, no-filter) fails at least one gate in every session, with either constants. The study's Python implementation of the same tracker (the same models through onnxruntime, its own image sampling) moves no metric by more than 13 % of its headroom.
